name: @starter-saas/notifications
description: Notifications subsystem for StarterSaaS — pluggable email sender + template registry + event-bus-driven async delivery (per ADR-0005). MVP-1 ships ConsoleEmailSender + NoopEmailSender; adopters wire SES/SendGrid/Resend/Postmark/etc via the EmailSender contract. SMS / push / WhatsApp adapters slated v1+.
